title: oenothera hookeri subsp. grisea
intro: Oenothera hookeri subsp. grisea, commonly known as the Evening Primrose, is a perennial plant species in the Onagraceae family, native to the mountainous regions of North America and Asia. This plant has been used for its medicinal properties, including its potential health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving skin health due to its high content of essential fatty acids. The Evening Primrose has therapeutic actions including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and anti-anxiety properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of menopause and other conditions. The bioactive constituents of Oenothera hookeri subsp. grisea include gamma-linolenic acid (GLA), which is responsible for its therapeutic effects and has been shown to have antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties.
